Shepherd

You listen for the wavering voice and help it find its way back to the others.

Rules

Agreed: minimum 0 in Reason, Guile; HP contribution +3. No multiclassing.

Starting disciplines: choose two distinct rank-1 disciplines from Life, Radiance, Medicine, Wilderness.

Discipline pricing: Home: Life, Radiance. Adjacent: Medicine, Wilderness. All others Foreign; no Opposed disciplines.

Choose one class-exclusive signature at levels 1, 3 and 7. Extra signatures cost 2/4/8 DP. No discipline requirements.

Level 1 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.12fc0ae8f9dfe1e6.JournalEntryPage.9c8d697ba5d2b312]{Gentle Return} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2716be19233a1e1b.JournalEntryPage.26662ebf3f6c1063]{Hear Me Still} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.1aacbbaed47d4b68.JournalEntryPage.639af58c1a179737]{Ease the Burden}

Level 3 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0dc602e1e05068b5.JournalEntryPage.f43b1e9b7b30087e]{Quiet the Tremor} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.266c4266412db19f.JournalEntryPage.0fb042e3bb4de94a]{Bring Them Near} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.2375e6c04f638cc8.JournalEntryPage.5940af2699222e91]{Careful Transfer}

Level 7 choices

- @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0f20822d73e3a14c.JournalEntryPage.16d5333f2d33dd35]{A Hand in Darkness} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.9cdcaa8c92aa23d3.JournalEntryPage.9162feacdbbec0b0]{Restore Composure} - @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.72d2b18792163d63.JournalEntryPage.0d31c92de528bf1f]{Shared Resolve}

Signature identity in play

The revised options aim for these moments, with a deliberate advantage over shared cards of their tier. Each is an independent choice, not a progression chain.

- Level 1: Support returning movement, stabilize at range, or ease a condition. - Level 3: Calm shock, call the wounded nearer, or transfer life carefully. - Level 7: Reach the dying, restore health and composure, or settle a whole group's distress.

Starting coin contribution: +3 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
